args.title: Skip scheduled exports for empty reports
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

When a report has no transactions, the scheduled export should be skipped to avoid sending emails with '(0 rows)'. This change will reduce unnecessary email traffic when there are no refunds.
